question: A UCS B-Series server located in B5108 chassis 1 slot 1 is currently unavailable. The server needs to be associated with a specific service profile when it becomes available. Which associate service profile option should be selected to accomplish this goal?
theory: When associating a service profile to a server that is not currently available/discovered, Cisco UCS Manager offers a 'custom server' (specific server) association option that lets you point the profile at an exact chassis/slot location — e.g., chassis 1 slot 1 — even though that physical server is not yet present or reachable. This differs from associating against a server pool (which picks any qualifying server dynamically) or a generic 'server' selection, making custom/specific server assignment the right choice when a precise future physical location must be pinned. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Service Profile Association)
